Who we are

A welcoming church with a
big heart and Vision.

First Baptist Church, Kajo-Keji exists to practice the way of Jesus with open doors, Scripture-centered faith, and honest grace.

01Our story

Rooted in Kajo-Keji,
open to every story.

We are a growing, intergenerational community in the heart of Kajo-Keji—rooted in Scripture, shaped by grace, and sent into the world with open hands.

Whether you are exploring faith, finding your way back, or looking for a place to put down roots, there is space for you here. Come for the worship and stay for the people.
